plan: 77.44.6.1.C — dockable workspace layout and local profiles

verified_in_scope: Six allowlisted desktop dock orders; keyboard/touch selector and native desktop drag-and-drop.
Live before/after/group drop-zone preview and application, including both panel-group modes and all saved dock orders.
Canvas-safe grouping, ungrouping, moving, resize, reload, workspace Undo/Redo and responsive single-drawer behavior.
Versioned, bounded, allowlisted local profiles; export/import in isolated browser contexts; explicit apply; duplicate-ID/name and size/limit rejection; storage-denial feedback.
Same-origin cross-tab synchronization, stale history invalidation and no Page Model, Save or Publish writes.
remaining_scope: No arbitrary recursive panel-group tree is implemented; the shell has two fixed top-level docks, each with its own inner tabs, and one tabbed group can contain the two docks.
No freeform desktop window is implemented. Floating mode is a raised panel card in a reserved dock track; it intentionally does not overlap the editing canvas.
The final runtime release is not on the remote branch and its post-deploy public health/asset verification is blocked in this session.
